2026_02_GB_NYJ.headline: Attrition in both defensive fronts puts protection at the center of Packers–Jets
2026_02_GB_NYJ.paragraph1: Green Bay and New York enter Sunday with meaningful defensive absences. Packers tackle Javon Hargrave was downgraded to out and Warren Brinson is also unavailable, although Lukas Van Ness cleared concussion protocol. The Jets ruled out Minkah Fitzpatrick and edge Joseph Ossai, with Will McDonald IV questionable. Green Bay must prevent New York’s remaining rushers from disrupting timing, while the Jets need their reshuffled defense to limit explosives despite missing help on the back end and edge.
2026_02_GB_NYJ.model_rationale: Protection quality and explosive-play prevention loom largest because both defenses are adjusting around unavailable starters, making clean early-down offense especially valuable for each quarterback.
